seasonRead.headline: 2022–23: Territory, defensive detail and inside scoring share the attack
paragraphs: Two-Way Shot-Share Driver is best understood through the lower rate of opponent attempts and chances attached to the group. The identity is territorial: spend less of the shift defending and give the offense another turn.

Shot-Blocking Contact Specialist supplies block-and-support work rather than a pure contact story, while Interior Net-Front Finisher owns the clearest rebound and high-danger fingerprint. Those jobs form a useful sequence—stabilize the shift, tilt the ice, then finish inside.

seasonRead.headline: 2022–23: Shot blocking is the workload; transition is the escape
paragraphs: Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman is the majority identity, defined by blocks and heavy shot exposure. That can be valuable labor, but it also means the opponent had enough possession to make the block necessary.

Puck-Pressure Transition Defenseman offers the countermeasure: take the puck away and attach offense to the recovery. In pairing terms, the contrast is between absorbing shot pressure and getting the shift moving in the other direction.
